literature_evidence.citation: Gallusser B, Weigert M. Trackastra: Transformer-based cell tracking for live-cell microscopy. ECCV 2024.
literature_evidence.reported_result: Temporal windows of 3 to 6 performed well; parental softmax reduced bacteria AOGM by about 20%, and shallow-feature Trackastra reduced AOGM about 70% versus the cited state of the art.
literature_evidence.task_relevance: The measured fit-only failure is ranking correct parents under dense competition; temporal all-detection attention and an explicit no-parent parental softmax directly model that failure without a volumetric encoder.

hypothesis.observed_failure_mode: Pairwise and temporal MLP gates either over-abstain or lose precision across videos and families despite accessible correct edges.
hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: A three-frame compact transformer over detection tokens learns relative competition and motion context, while parental softmax provides an explicit no-parent choice.
hypothesis.falsification_test: On the frozen 105/12 fit-only split, reject unless grouped OOF and both-family validation precision reach 0.95 and capped validation utility exceeds the exact pair-NCC control by at least 5.

early_stop_conditions: Stop on any memory, free-memory, or swap guard violation.
Stop if capped validation utility has not improved after 500 optimizer steps.
Stop if overall or either-family validation precision is below 0.93.
Stop if the measured continuation cannot finish inside seven hours.
success_criteria: Grouped out-of-fold precision is at least 0.95.
Validation precision is at least 0.95 for both 44b6 and 6bba.
Validation capped utility is at least 5 above the exact pair-NCC control.
Utility change is non-negative on both families.
Artifact provenance proves fit117-only access and reproducibility.

decision_basis: Coordinator pre-training gate review: primary peer-reviewed mechanism evidence, fit-only 105/12 falsification, 6 GiB projected peak, 90-minute pilot cap, explicit no-holdout/no-swap contract, and preregistered precision/utility failure gates all satisfy compute_governance_v1. PASS authorizes only the guarded local fit-only fast-fail; it does not authorize CV57, Kaggle, GPU, or RunPod work.
